newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire to print new money, central bank says.
newsitem.headline: Zaire to print new money, central bank says.

text.p: New Zaire banknotes, including one million zaire ($8.5) unit, will go into circulation from Monday, the central bank said on Friday.
"This emission will meet the demands of monetary circulation," Bank of Zaire's director for monetary emissions, Victor Mwazaka, told Reuters.

The three new banknotes will be in demoninations of 100,000 zaire, 500,000 zaire and one million zaire. The new notes would initially be printed in Germany but the Bank of Zaire would take over the job eventually, Mwazaka said.
The issue of new currency is politically sensitive in volatile Zaire, where the government has frequently resorted to printing new money as an economic expedience.

The announcement of the new issue coincided with the government's declaration that it was ready to provide its unpaid soldiers the resources they need to combat rebels who have seized territory in eastern Zaire.

Riots broke out in 1992 during an opposition-led boycott of new banknotes, including a five million zaire unit. The notes now in circulation were issued a year later when Zaire launched an economic reform programme.
